text: A key limitation of the synthetic-biology 'reconstruction' strategy for cognition is that a working synthetic system reveals:
choices: Nothing about cognition, because synthetic systems are not truly alive
The sufficient conditions for a behavior, but not whether the natural organism evolved that same mechanism
The phenomenal experience of the organism directly
Only the anthropocentric baseline of the researcher
explanation: A synthetic circuit that reproduces a cognitive behavior demonstrates a set of sufficient conditions for that behavior, but not that the natural organism arrived at the same solution, since nature may implement the same function by a different mechanism. It is not that synthetic systems reveal nothing (option 0) or expose phenomenal experience (option 2), and the anthropocentric baseline (option 3) is a separate issue.
